notes.title: Slender Threads: Prologue is out today!
notes.content:
Dear friends!

We'd like to share the release of Slender Threads' Prologue.

Slender Threads is a point-and-click thriller adventure with spreads of fun. We hope it'll make you jump off your chair and steal a good laugh.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34881265/cbf13592241ae718b4cc4a6b41ace040b87607fd.jpg[/img]

[h3]About Slender Threads[/h3]

The moment he arrives in Villa Ventana, Harvey Green rolls his eyes. All he sees is one more lifeless town, no different from countless others he passes through as a traveling bookseller.
What Harvey is not seeing is that he has been called to Villa Ventana to play a part. Strings, pulled by some hidden presence, begin drawing him into a web of inevitability.
A recurring nightmare. Citizen disappearances. A chain of alluringly inexplicable events sets Harvey on a path toward a terrifying revelation about his own destiny.
Slender Threads explores the connections between disparate events and the extent to which we possess the agency to alter our fated course.

The prologue represents around 1 of the 8-10 hours of the full game. Featuring English voice acting, and Spanish, French, German, Italian subtitles.

If you love the idea and want to join us on this new adventure, there are two ways you can help us:
[list]
[*] Playing the Free Prologue and leaving us a review!
[*] Sharing it (tweets, emails, old classic phone calls are welcomed if they help to spread the news!)
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1682490/Slender_Threads_Prologue/

Also, don't forget to add the full version to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1116480/Slender_Threads/

Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for giving us your time!

All things said.
Dare to follow the Slender Threads?

notes.title: Quick update on our new adventure game
notes.content:
Hey there! 

Hope you are healthy and safe at home. Here in Argentina we are still under lockdown, and we used this time to keep working on our latest project.

Slender Threads, our new adventure game, is taking part of the Steam Game Festival. A free demo is available to play during the festival (until 22nd June), so, if you were wondering what to do this weekend, we've got you covered =)  

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1116480/Slender_Threads/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11979630/6eaf9e67a2d5fd7071f023d564bbad6c1096ba68.jpg[/img][/url]

You can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1116480/Slender_Threads/]download the demo here[/url] 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1116480/Slender_Threads/

We’ve also created a discord channel to keep you up to date on news, upcoming events and release dates. [url=https://discord.gg/BZeKADw]Join the community here[/url], we’d like to hear from you!

[url=https://discord.gg/BZeKADw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11979630/e13b67d82402667213dd90fc3c15aaf2b433f61a.jpg[/img][/url]

Thanks!
The Blyts Team

notes.title: Infamous Machine Launches!
notes.content:
We have news. Big news. HUUUGE news:

[b]Kelvin and the Infamous machine will officially release on PC, Mac, and Linux on Thursday, July 21st![/b]

To refresh your memory, here’s what the full release includes that the Early Access release does not:
[list]
[*]Steam achievements.
[*]Text translations for French, German, and Spanish.
[*]Various usability improvements, including a “Show Hotspots” button in case you get stuck.
[*]A few extra secrets scattered around... 
[*]Oh right, and FULL ENGLISH VOICE ACTING!
[/list]

[b]Giveaway[/b]
Help us get the word out about the game by [url=http://thndr.me/eGU3k4]supporting us on Thunderclap.[/url] and get one of the 5 Steam Keys we'll be giving on this pre launching giveaway!
